integrity: The exhaustive verifier checks every labeled nine-edge graph using an exact simple-path characterization of saturation, then performs exact degree-preserving canonicalization. Independent audit, proof-assistant verification, and expert attestation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and restricted to \(n=8\); no structural classification for larger orders is claimed.
Completeness is computer-assisted through exhaustive enumeration of all nine-edge graphs on eight labeled vertices.
Best-of-knowledge novelty was checked by targeted literature and semantic searches, not by an exhaustive historical bibliography.
title: Six extremal \(\mathcal C_{[4,6]}\)-saturated graphs on eight vertices
